title: RegRegSEA: a web server for regulatory region set enrichment analysis of epigenomic data.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.19731482 (one 25.7 kB code zip, v1.0.0) and the GitHub repo top level (R package: DESCRIPTION, R/, man/, vignettes/, MIT-style LICENSE file). Supplement listing is figures plus a 51 kB PDF; no data tables.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Data availability says no new data were generated; demo re-analyses use public GEO GSE198186 (Down syndrome brain methylation) and an ageing mouse liver chromatin accessibility study. Reference region sets (UniBind, LOLA, JASPAR 2014) are third-party.

a1_downloadable.note: Code downloads freely from GitHub and Zenodo; but it is software, not a dataset.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists. The tool outputs enrichment scores (GSEA, gene set enrichment analysis, applied to genomic regions); any label would have to be constructed from re-analysed third-party data. Checked in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: No input feature table released; only R code.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Trivially small, but there is nothing to model.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper states no new data; files confirm that.

a8_label_provenance.note: Only candidate outputs (enrichment scores) are statistics computed by the tool itself from its inputs, so they are circular as labels.

honest_claim_h3: None: this is a web server and R package for enrichment analysis with no new dataset, so no model claim can be made from it.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use differential methylation or accessibility results to predict which transcription-factor binding programs are enriched.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many differential-region tables from public studies; none are released with this paper. Number of examples: unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Enrichment of regulatory region sets, but the 'truth' would be the tool's own statistic, not an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little: the output is a deterministic statistic the tool already computes quickly, so a model would only imitate it.

ml_idea: None viable; the paper is a software/web-server resource with no new data and no measured outcome.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: no dataset to model.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement plus repo listing: no data released (done).

verdict_reason: Software-only web server paper; no new data, no label column (A2 fails), and its outputs are computed statistics, not measurements.
